text:
You're not broke. You're just waiting to be chosen.

Some man with money or power or a company will see you and say yes.

That's not how it works.

The men who built what they wanted didn't wait for permission.

They got close to the people doing the work. They took positions that kept them near the goal. Low pay. No prestige. Didn't matter.

Because they had a stage to prove themselves every single day.

They built credibility from the inside.

You know what to do. Get close and prove it.
caption:
Waiting for permission is how the weak stay weak. Real success demands you pick yourself first, then prove it from within. Send this to a man who needs it today.
#discipline #mindset #ambition #selfdevelopment #success
